reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.28 (the cbor wire): packs/dtn-bpv7/pack.def and pack.md; RFC 9171 4.1 (bundle), 4.3.1 (primary block), 4.3.2 (canonical block), 4.2.1 (CRC); The primary block is a map (a8, keys 0 to 7) where the paths take [0].[i] steps. Reading step 7 comes before step 8: the common when [0].[0] 7 passes through a map where its next step is a position, so it does not hold, and a common when that fails is no-kind (0.5 Decode step 1), before step 8 would report malformed-wire. Derived without an engine by a standalone RFC 8949 codec.
